status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction / operating legacy campus. The City of The Dalles' current Google Data Centers page states that Google has operated data centers in The Dalles since 2006, with four buildings across two sites and a third site adding two additional buildings. City council minutes from 2024-12-09 describe the Google SIP funds as part of a development agreement for new data centers under construction. The city says Google completed new water and sewer infrastructure in 2025 as part of former smelter-site redevelopment and transferred it to city ownership. Google announced on 2025-10-22 that the related ASR water-storage system and groundwater rights were permanently transferred to the city, adding over 100 million gallons annually for public benefit. Avangrid announced on 2025-07-22 a PPA for more than 100 MW from Leaning Juniper IIB to support Google's The Dalles data centers via Northern Wasco County PUD. No public source reviewed gives building-specific commissioning, certificate of occupancy, or IT capacity MW for the expansion.
evidence_grade: A- official city, state, Google, and Avangrid sources verify active operations, six-building/three-site local description, construction-era status, completed support infrastructure, SIP framework, and >100 MW renewable PPA; public evidence still lacks building-level permit/CO/energization and IT capacity.
